events.verdict: LHH shows Johnson (MIA) makes contact to McCollum's (POR) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Dragic (MIA) makes contact to Lillard's (POR) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Dragic (MIA) sets the screen on McCollum (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) sets the screen on McCollum (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) makes contact to Lillard's (POR) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Olynyk (MIA) firms up his position and sets the screen on McCollum (POR).
Aminu (POR) makes incidental contact with Waiters (MIA) that does not affect his SQBR.
Davis (POR) and Olynyk (MIA) briefly engage and separate during rebounding.
Olynyk (MIA) makes incidental contact with Lillard (POR) that does not affect his SQBR.
Johnson (MIA) dislodges the ball away from Lillard (POR), who regathers and takes a legal amount of steps.
[Observable in enhanced video] McCollum (POR) splits his feet on the perimeter.
McCollum (POR) makes incidental contact with Dragic (MIA) off ball.
Johnson (MIA) commits a take foul on Turner (POR).
Dragic (MIA) sets the screen on Aminu (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Aminu (POR) legally contests Olynyk's (MIA) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
